finding: Rebuild the product page around the buyer’s decision
disposition: Recomposed product journey: proposition/sample, process, comparable engagements, access, resources, FAQ.

finding: Keep contents navigation on long mobile pages
disposition: Native contents disclosures at mobile/tablet; persistent sidebar on wide screens.

finding: Make contact entry the main content
disposition: Contact form is the primary content; name and email appear in the opening viewport.

finding: Add the missing completed-submission goal
disposition: Account dependency remains: the existing Sites API authority refused goal creation (401). Client success event is preserved; configuration is not claimed complete.

finding: Align the promise and current availability across pages
disposition: Home/product metadata and opening copy align on synthetic simulation, no customer-model execution and agreed pre-release access; unverified portal promise removed.

finding: Fix the half-width final service card
disposition: Three equal-width engagement rows replace the broken stacked-card grid.

finding: Make the existing report explain the product
disposition: Existing synthetic report preview and directly adjacent PDF action appear near the proposition.

finding: Fix alignment, line measure and small-text hierarchy
disposition: Left-aligned prose, wider mobile measure, ordinary-size essential notes, aligned plain lists and clear keyboard focus.

finding: Give the strongest hierarchy to buyer value
disposition: Buyer value, scope and sample lead; detailed regulatory context remains accessible in relevant sections/disclosure.

finding: Name the pack and the next step consistently
disposition: Buyer-pack actions consistently explain the written reply and its contents; specialist security-pack route retained.

finding: Put terms and delivery approval before installation
disposition: Procurement sequence now confirms availability and terms/approval before preparation and installation.

finding: Declare input purposes for autofill and assistive tools
disposition: Input purposes declared for name, email, organisation and role.

finding: Move focus when a section link is activated
disposition: Section activation transfers focus; subsequent Tab continues in the section. Menu-to-contents scroll-shift defect also fixed.

finding: Honor reduced-motion preferences in navigation
disposition: Local navigation honors reduced motion; ordinary navigation retains smooth scrolling.

finding: Make privacy actions directly reachable
disposition: Trust Center offers contextual privacy-notice links and the published privacy role inbox.

finding: Provide usable navigation when scripts are unavailable
disposition: Primary links remain visible without JavaScript; contact email fallback stays available.

finding: Explain the whitepaper and supporting files before download
disposition: Downloads identify format/size and supporting synthetic inputs; whitepaper shows verified 11-page count and 6 June 2026 demo build date.

finding: Present media assets visually
disposition: Press shows original light/dark logo previews, format-labelled downloads and subordinate implementation assets.

finding: Unify the rules that generate the live presentation
disposition: Current design spec, brand font guidance and behavioural/geometry regressions replace contradictory presentation rules.

finding: Explain pending requests and provide an honest recovery state
disposition: Immediate Sending status, bounded 15-second wait, preserved fields, honest uncertain-delivery recovery and no automatic retry. Live status has no busy ancestor.

finding: Exclude honeypot submissions from the attempt counter
disposition: Attempt event occurs only after validation/honeypot guard; accepted event only after HTTP 2xx.
